cohort: The study included 238 women who underwent planned uterine-preserving surgery for Placenta Accreta Spectrum (PAS), comparing those with successful preservation to those requiring unplanned immediate hysterectomy.
finding: Preoperative sonographic presence of lacunae and loss of clear zone were independently associated with an increased risk of unplanned immediate hysterectomy during planned uterine-preserving surgeries for Placenta Accreta Spectrum.
mod_finding: The number of previous cesarean deliveries was significantly lower in the group that underwent successful uterine-preserving surgery compared to those requiring unplanned immediate hysterectomy.
